$comment: Owner-editable settings. storeUrl: paste the real Google Play listing URL when it exists; while empty, every download button reads 'Coming to Google Play' and links to the download section. siteUrl: the deployed root (change it when a custom domain is added). Items in knownPlaceholders are owner inputs still outstanding (see docs/OWNER-DETAILS-NEEDED.md); scripts/check.mjs fails if a page publishes any other [... REQUIRED] marker.

seo.$comment: googleSiteVerification: the content value of Search Console's HTML-tag verification (docs/SEO-MANUAL-STEPS.md, Step 4). Leave empty until you have it; the tag is then added to the home page.
